title: Ray Dalio
html: Who: Founded Bridgewater, one of the world's largest hedge funds. Creator of the "All Weather" balanced approach. Core ideas: Economies move in short and long debt cycles; diversify across assets that do well in different environments (growth/inflation up or down); radical transparency in decisions. Read: Principles; Principles for Dealing with the Changing World Order; How Countries Go Broke. Now: Has warned of a particularly risky period for the U.S. between the 2026 and 2028 elections (Yahoo Finance). Bridgewater's Pure Alpha was up 18.4% through Sept 2026. For our plan: Don't bet everything on one outcome; know how SPY behaves when inflation rises (like now). Back to Council of Masters
